p6_b5.ocr: Among the cohort, a significant proportion of patients, 209 (71.3%), experienced these symptoms, underscoring the urgent nature of their medical condition. The table further elucidates the diagnostic techniques employed, revealing that lung infections were primarily identified through sputum cultures, chest X-rays, and high-resolution CT scans.

p6_b6.ocr: Additionally, the immunological status of patients is reflected in the CD4+ cell counts, with an average of 133 cells/μl observed, alongside a viral load of 40,700 copies/ml of HIV-1 RNA. This information is crucial for understanding the interplay between HIV status and susceptibility to R. equi infections, informing both treatment strategies and patient management protocols.
